Web framework failures progressed beyond the old focus-readiness check: command
selection expected `/compare ` but observed an empty draft. The independent W3C
drivers now preserve terminal integration responses. Chrome, Edge and Firefox
reached model dismissal; Edge retained a specific assertion at
`catalog_browser_input_test.dart:124`: the expected multiline draft had become
empty after Escape. Chrome and Firefox retained the integration test's aggregate
two-exception result. Individual exceptions were not expanded in that aggregate.
The JSON retains every browser's exact stage boundary and terminal summary,
including Safari. A pending next stage is not evidence that its action ran.

The ordinary Orca capability job timed out during its initial five-second
GI/GTK import, before launching the reader or collecting capability evidence.
Narrator again observed its fixture and ordinary keyboard response but had no
default WASAPI render endpoint (`0x80070490`); speech and AT navigation remained
unaccepted. Neither failure was retried or converted into success.

The Catalog pilot's runner and build provenance both identify the commit above.
Its PTY captured **1,165,603 original bytes**, reached EOF, stopped its reader and
reported no capture error. The GTK preflight passed. Catalog PID 5920 exposed a
complete 421-node native tree, but 96 Theme Tab commands never produced focus on
the target control. Only the Flutter panel remained focused. Thinking traversal
then used 29 commands before the 240-second total deadline; Search issued none.
All task reader-checkpoint lists remained empty and cleanup was verified.

The native Theme node at `[1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]` was a showing push button with
`enabled=false` and `focused=false`. The focused panel was `[1,0,0]`; panel focus
was not accepted as control focus. Search inspection also exposed a concrete GI
method-name collision: `Atspi.Accessible.get_text()` rejected two range arguments.
The subsequent explicit `Atspi.Text` dispatch fix needs its own real execution.
No cache, focus or acceptance condition was relaxed to alter this result.

[351d7c4f-ci.json](./351d7c4f-ci.json) retains all run/job IDs, core report
